qc.label_under_test: Fires on chemistry nouns for a prepared mixture of substances (solution, composition, solvents, mixture) when used about chemicals; quiet on 'solution' meaning an answer to a problem and on chemistry sentences without such a noun.

neighbours.label: Fires on wet-chemistry word pieces ('aqueous', 'solvents', 'composition', 'mixture', 'solution', 'conditions') in chemistry or materials text, not only on mixture nouns; weaker for composition/mixture outside chemistry, and quiet on 'solution' meaning an answer.
fire: The salt was dissolved in an aqueous phase before titration with sodium hydroxide.
Polar solvents such as methanol and acetonitrile were screened for the coupling reaction.
The elemental composition of the alloy was determined by X-ray fluorescence.
The reaction mixture was stirred at reflux for six hours under nitrogen.
A 0.1 M solution of copper sulfate was prepared in deionized water.
Under acidic conditions, the ester hydrolyzes rapidly to the carboxylic acid.
